messages.en: That book's hard to find. Have you tried getting it at the shop next door?
Yep, I managed to get it earlier. There was only one copy left!
I've landed at KLIA. Are you here yet?
Yep, I'm waiting in the arrivals hall. Go and get your bags first.

senses.en_definition: To hear or listen to sounds or voices.
To receive news or information; to learn of something from others.
To pay attention to, consider, or act on someone's words, advice, or instructions.

messages.en: Have you listened to the song I shared earlier?
I'm listening to it right now. His voice is so good!
Right? Listen to it all the way through. The bit at the end is the best.

collocations.en: hear it for the first time

messages.en: I've sent you the recording. Have you listened to it yet?
Yeah, but your voice is way too quiet. Can you send it again?
